note: Seeded 22 November 2026 for the Gordon Ramsay restaurants in London guide. SCOPE: every London restaurant the group lists as open on gordonramsayrestaurants.com on 22 November 2026, ranked by how many independent sources recommend each one. This is a venue-led topic, so a source counts only where it recommends the named restaurant: reviews that end positive, award listings, and best-of lists. Negative reviews are kept out and listed under notCounted. VENUE IDENTITY: Lucky Cat Mayfair and Lucky Cat 22 Bishopsgate are two restaurants with two kitchens, and Bread Street Kitchen is recorded per branch where a source names the branch. Two mentions of plain 'Lucky Cat' (Conde Nast Traveller sushi list, Luxury London afternoon tea list) are NOT counted here because neither names the branch. SEARCH ROUTE: Google News RSS decoded to real URLs (multi-word queries), each masthead's own review page, the Michelin Guide's own restaurant pages, and YouTube search results pages. Reddit is not reachable from this environment, so no tier E. TIER D: YouTube only; TikTok search cannot be read without a paid scraper. Video transcripts are not readable, so a creator is recorded only where the title or description itself states the creator's view or places the restaurant in a recommended list.

sources.name: MICHELIN Guide - Restaurant Gordon Ramsay (2026 guide)

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay: THREE MICHELIN STARS, 2026 guide. 68-69 Royal Hospital Road, Chelsea, SW3 4HP. Inspectors: Gordon Ramsay 'still remains fiercely committed to maintaining the highest standards at his elegant yet relaxed flagship restaurant'.

sources.name: MICHELIN Guide - Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High (2026 guide)

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High: ONE MICHELIN STAR, new in the 2026 guide. 60th floor, 22 Bishopsgate. Inspectors: the 12-seater counter faces the window and the view over the city.

sources.name: MICHELIN Guide - Pétrus by Gordon Ramsay (2026 guide)

quotes.Pétrus by Gordon Ramsay: ONE MICHELIN STAR, 2026 guide. Inspectors: named after the Pomerol estate, wine plays a pivotal role at this impeccably run restaurant for well-to-do locals and special occasions.

sources.name: MICHELIN Guide - 1890 by Gordon Ramsay (2026 guide)

quotes.Restaurant 1890 by Gordon Ramsay: ONE MICHELIN STAR, 2026 guide. Inspectors: an intimate restaurant next to The Savoy's American Bar, named for the year Escoffier joined the hotel; comfortable and discreet.

sources.name: MICHELIN Guide - Savoy Grill (2026 guide)

quotes.Savoy Grill: Listed in the 2026 guide without a star. Inspectors: 'something undeniably decadent about dining at this iconic restaurant', entered through the hotel lobby.

sources.name: MICHELIN Guide - Restaurant Gordon Ramsay: The Inspectors Tell All

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay: A Michelin inspector's first-hand account, headed 'on its understated brilliance'; the flagship 'continues to soar with Three MICHELIN Stars'.

sources.name: The Good Food Guide - review of Restaurant Gordon Ramsay, Chelsea

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay: Anonymous inspector. The lobster, langoustine and salmon ravioli has been on the menu since day one; a 100-day aged Cumbrian Blue Grey sirloin was 'perfectly medium-rare' and 'oh-so tender'.

sources.name: The Infatuation - review of Restaurant Gordon Ramsay, Chelsea

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay: 'An old-school fine dining restaurant in Chelsea that makes brilliant British food'; walls are cream, the ceiling low, and the music is waiting-room playlist.

sources.name: Time Out - Every Michelin-starred Restaurant in London 2026

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay: Rated 4 out of 5 and 'Recommended': 'Another entry for this Michelin powerhouse'; Ramsay no longer cooks there himself.
quotes.Pétrus by Gordon Ramsay: Rated 4 out of 5 and 'Recommended': a room 'enveloped in shades of pearlescent pink and dusky greys' around a circular wine store; 'the food is all about indulgence and luxury ingredients'.
quotes.Restaurant 1890 by Gordon Ramsay: Rated 5 out of 5 and 'Recommended': 'A small but powerful hotel restaurant', ten tables inside the Savoy.
quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High: Listed as new for 2026: a 12-seater on the 60th floor of 22 Bishopsgate.

sources.name: Time Out - Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High review

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High: 3 out of 5. 'Sixty floors up. One Michelin star. Twelve seats. Ten courses. Oh, and £250 a head.'

sources.name: Time Out - Savoy Grill review

quotes.Savoy Grill: 4 out of 5. 'Heaves with history and celebrity stories. The food is great, too.'

sources.name: Time Out - Lucky Cat review

quotes.Lucky Cat Mayfair: 3 out of 5 for the Mayfair original. 'Specifically, the food is excellent'; once it dropped its claims of authenticity it became a pan-Asian pick-and-mix of sushi, buns, skewers and dumplings.

sources.name: Hot Dinners - The best high-rise restaurants in London

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High: 'The all-chef's-table Michelin-starred affair with views down to the Tower of London'.
quotes.Lucky Cat 22 Bishopsgate: Listed beside High as the more affordable of the two highest restaurants in London.

sources.name: Country & Town House - review of The Savoy Grill

quotes.Savoy Grill: After the refurbishment 'the grande dame of London's restaurants' has 'recaptured its glorious past'; the apple tarte tatin 'one of the best I have ever tasted'.

sources.name: Country & Town House - review of Lucky Cat, Mayfair

quotes.Lucky Cat Mayfair: Headed 'remains top of its game': excellent Asian-inspired food and cocktails; egg fried rice mixed at the table by the waiter.

sources.name: Country & Town House - review of Pétrus by Gordon Ramsay

quotes.Pétrus by Gordon Ramsay: 'Outstanding food, world-class wine and a surprisingly relaxed atmosphere'; ends on the plaisir sucré, a chocolate, hazelnut and fruit stack.

sources.name: Country & Town House - Lucky Cat at 22 Bishopsgate

quotes.Lucky Cat 22 Bishopsgate: The mandarin pannacotta, an orange-shaped white chocolate shell the waiter has you smash, is the show-stopper.

sources.name: Foodepedia - The Savoy Grill review

quotes.Savoy Grill: Opens 'The spiritual heart of England is the Savoy Grill'; the Arnold Bennett is now a soufflé, and 'gorgeous'.

sources.name: Foodepedia - Bread Street Kitchen, Floor 59, 22 Bishopsgate review

quotes.Bread Street Kitchen 22 Bishopsgate: The Duroc pork chop comes with the bone on the side; 'the best pork I've eaten outside of Spain'.

sources.name: The Luxury Editor - Savoy Grill review

quotes.Savoy Grill: The Beef Wellington is 'opulent, extravagant, indulgent' and works without sides; the service is 'excellent'.

sources.name: Luxury Lifestyle Magazine - Savoy Grill review

quotes.Savoy Grill: Called 'a powerhouse on London's dining scene'; the kitchen is run by Arnaud Stevens.

sources.name: Luxury Lifestyle Magazine - Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High review

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High: Highlights lobster ravioli with yuzu and Devon duck with morels and pine nut, and the wine pairings.

sources.name: Luxury Lifestyle Magazine - Lucky Cat Mayfair review

quotes.Lucky Cat Mayfair: Describes Grosvenor Square as vivacious, with curvaceous booths and oxblood leather.

sources.name: Spear's - Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High review

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High: 'Hits new heights': a three-hour dinner with UK-sourced ingredients; the chilled tomato tea an early contender for dish of the night.

sources.name: London On The Inside - High review

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High: 'Reach for the stars': a menu of the greatest hits of 25 years of Restaurant Gordon Ramsay, with views partly obscured by cloud on the night.

sources.name: Elite Traveler - What it's like to dine at 22 Bishopsgate

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High: Scallops in chamomile velouté, oyster ice cream, confit turbot with Jersey Royals, langoustine in kataifi pastry.
quotes.Lucky Cat 22 Bishopsgate: 'The playful cousin', best enjoyed as a social destination rather than a purist's culinary exercise.

sources.name: ShortList - Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High, the 12-seat chef's table

quotes.Restaurant Gordon Ramsay High: 'Very premium' but 'seriously worth it'; a non-alcoholic pairing is made with BAEK.

sources.name: Luxury London - Lucky Cat at 22 Bishopsgate

quotes.Lucky Cat 22 Bishopsgate: The Iberico pork chop is 'a showstopper'; the baby squid disappointed. Would return for the pork, the wagyu and the late hour.

sources.name: The Manual - Lucky Cat 22 Bishopsgate

quotes.Lucky Cat 22 Bishopsgate: Ordered a la carte rather than a tasting menu, three to four plates each on the waiter's advice; a nori martini finished with soy sauce.

sources.name: City AM - Lucky Cat at 22 Bishopsgate

quotes.Lucky Cat 22 Bishopsgate: Padron peppers with basil dipping sauce, then sushi, a rice bowl and the grilled meat; 'service is attentive and cocktails sharply made'.

sources.name: City AM - Bread Street Kitchen, Floor 59, 22 Bishopsgate

quotes.Bread Street Kitchen 22 Bishopsgate: The Australian wagyu picanha 'straightforwardly but brilliantly cooked'; grilled dishes with unusual spins such as an XL king prawn.

sources.name: The London Economic - The River Restaurant, The Savoy
names: The River Restaurant by Gordon Ramsay

quotes.The River Restaurant by Gordon Ramsay: 'One of the quietly great hotel restaurants is back in the game'; devilled crab on sourdough crumpets (£25) 'spectacular'; fish and chips £29.50.

sources.name: The London Economic - Bread Street Kitchen, Bishopsgate

quotes.Bread Street Kitchen 22 Bishopsgate: At 278 metres 'altitude becomes the opening act'; the creamed spinach laced with nutmeg shows 'this chef knows what he is doing'.

sources.name: MyLondon - Gordon Ramsay's Hell's Kitchen, Marble Arch

quotes.Hell's Kitchen London: Expected a gimmick tied to the TV show; the Beef Wellington made it 'one of the most impressive dining experiences' the writer has had in London. A five-course tasting menu is offered.

sources.name: MyLondon - Gordon Ramsay Street Burger

quotes.Street Burger: Headline: the £16 burger meal 'puts the expensive Harrods one to shame' (price from January 2022).

sources.name: Express - Gordon Ramsay's Hell's Kitchen London

quotes.Hell's Kitchen London: The standout is the scallops, 'how beautiful scallops can be when they're cooked just right'; the Idiot Sandwich is a short rib with spiced tomato chutney.

sources.name: Square Mile - Pétrus by Gordon Ramsay celebrates 25 years

quotes.Pétrus by Gordon Ramsay: 'A quarter of a century later, it's better than ever'; four wine flights, two tasting menus and a la carte, which can be mixed at one table.

sources.name: Essential Surrey - Restaurant 1890 by Gordon Ramsay

quotes.Restaurant 1890 by Gordon Ramsay: A crab course on muffins and an 'exceptional' mango and passionfruit mille-feuille finished at the table.
